provenance.rain: CHIRPS v2.0 (Funk et al. 2015, Scientific Data 2:150066), UCSB Climate Hazards Center
provenance.t2m_et_pet: ERA5-Land monthly (Munoz-Sabater et al. 2021), contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information (temperature_2m, total_evaporation_sum, potential_evaporation_sum)
provenance.region_means: area-weighted means over the region outline on a ~5 km (climate) or ~1 km (MODIS) grid
provenance.spi3: SPI-3 of the region-mean CHIRPS rainfall, gamma fit per calendar month on 1991-2020
provenance.lst_vhi: MODIS MOD11A2 / MOD13Q1 C6.1, mean over cells >= 50 % WorldCover cropland; null when < 30 % of them are cloud-free
provenance.asi: share of those cropland cells with VHI < 35 (FAO ASIS critical value), % of the cloud-free ones
provenance.smap: NASA/SMAP/SPL4SMGP/008 sm_rootzone (m3/m3), monthly mean, region mean at 9 km
provenance.oni: NOAA CPC Oceanic Nino Index (ERSSTv5), https://www.cpc.ncep.noaa.gov/data/indices/oni.ascii.txt, value of the 3-month season centred on each month
